{{Quote|My pleasure. CSF Staff and Social Club, all of you. End of the week. I will not take no for an answer and neither will CSF. Be there.|Jaller Obrim, to Kal Skirata and his commandos|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club''', also known as the '''CSF Social Club''' or '''CSF Bar''', was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that catered specifically to [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. The Social Club was the site of meetings between CSF [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] and his close friend, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]]. The Social Club also was the location of a special reception for members of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], [[Arca Company]], after a [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] aimed at dismantling several [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] cells.

==Description==
{{Quote|Well, that was fun. They don't drink much, your boys, do they?''"<br />"''They make up for it with eating.|Jaller Obrim and Kal Skirata after a CSF reception|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
The Coruscant Security Force Social Club was, by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a long-established [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was an exclusive club that allowed only [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] to enter. Exceptions for non&ndash;police officers were made if an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] extended an invitation. The Social Club had several open areas, private booths, a bar, and a separate bar for senior officers.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

==History==
{{Quote|Of course I've planned a way out. I've been a mercenary since I was seven years old. You always plan for what happens when the current war is over. It's called an exit strategy, and mine's been in the planning a long, long time.|Kal Skirata to Jaller Obrim, in a late night conversation at the CSF bar|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
In 21 BBY, [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] met at the CSF Social Club with CSF [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] to discuss the possibility of a leak in one of their organizations after one of their operations was compromised by [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, upon successfully [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|rooting out]] terrorist cells operating on Coruscant, a reception was held at the Social Club. It was hosted by the CSF's [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] and [[Organized Crime Unit]] in honor of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Arca Company]] and the efforts they had made in bringing down the terrorists. During the party, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] performed the [[Dha Werda Verda]] poem for the CSF cops.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

Later that evening, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] admitted to Kal Skirata that she and [[Darman Skirata]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]], were in love and that she was [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with his child. The revelation shocked Kal Skirata who became determined to plan an exit strategy to give his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] a normal life after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He discussed the issue with Obrim well into the early morning after the party had ended.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the CSF bar was in operation. In [[41 ABY]], in the aftermath of the [[Solo-Niathal coup|arrest]] of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Galactic Alliance, tales of Omas' bravery during the arrest circulated among the cops present at the bar.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The CSF Social Club first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', which was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />
